comparison.objective: Perform an ordered three-stage liquid dilution with a pipette and avoid contamination; candidate mechanically adjusts and validates an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pipette task tests bulb squeezing, liquid aspiration/dispensing, narrow-cup positioning, ordered transfers, and holder placement. Candidate tests hex-key alignment, setscrew manipulation, fine collar rotation, counterholding, force-limited locking, and guarded cycle control.
comparison.success_condition: Pipette success requires three target concentrations/volumes in order, no back-contamination or spill, and an empty released pipette returned to its holder. Candidate requires two acceptable physical stopping cycles and retained adjustment. Candidate rebound/drift limits are unspecified but irrelevant to the clearly different liquid-handling objective.
comparison.reason: Neither the mechanism nor the measured outcome overlaps beyond generic manipulation and sequencing.
